items.headline: FDA approves first heart valve that can grow with a child
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration approved a heart valve that doctors can expand inside a child's chest as the child grows, without open heart surgery. It is also the first approved heart valve to use a synthetic material for its inner flaps instead of animal tissue.
items.why_it_matters: Children with heart valve defects may need far fewer repeat open heart surgeries as they grow up.

items.headline: Judge rules Trump could not fire a court-appointed U.S. attorney
items.summary: A federal judge ruled that President Trump unlawfully fired Seattle's court-appointed U.S. attorney and ordered him reinstated. The judge said the Constitution does not give the president the power to remove a prosecutor that federal judges themselves appointed.
items.why_it_matters: The ruling is an early court check on the president's attempt to control federal prosecutors beyond what the law allows.

items.headline: Judge halts border wall construction in Big Bend National Park
items.summary: A federal judge in Texas issued an emergency injunction stopping construction of a border wall through Big Bend National Park and the surrounding region. She ruled that the government could not rely on legal waivers to skip environmental and other required reviews.
items.why_it_matters: The order protects one of the country's most ecologically important landscapes from immediate construction while the case continues.
